title: 14/18mm Male or Female Stand
description:
14/18mm Glass Stand
Keep your glass just that little more safer.
These stands can be used to hold water pipes that are fead in through the bottom. And the female stands are especially handy for holding injector bowls or bangers.
Please choose between the 18 and 14mm joint size as well as female or male joints.
Included
1 x 18mm or 14mm glass stand
